subject: Partner claim reconciliation: BlueFjord <> OrbitWare pipeline entanglement
messages:
From: Ava Morgan <ava@bluefjord.com>
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@orbitware.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Overlap on LumaHealth — need claim clarity

Evelyn — quick note from BlueFjord. We just uncovered that OrbitWare also engaged LumaHealth last week; they were included on a technical discovery. BlueFjord has an existing proof-of-concept (PoC) in flight (signed MOU in January) and we have active SOW talks. Attached is a short snapshot of our motion (bf_claims_snapshot.pdf).

Can we get help reconciling ownership? We don’t want two partners running parallel discovery with the same LumaHealth contacts. Luma mentioned both Redwood partner introductions.

Thanks,
Ava Morgan
Head of Partnerships
BlueFjord Consulting

Attachment: bf_claims_snapshot.pdf (summary PDF, 2 pages)

From: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Overlap on LumaHealth — need claim clarity

Team — forwarding BlueFjord's note. TL;DR: BlueFjord has a PoC and believes they have priority; OrbitWare is actively in discovery. We need a quick, defensible resolution so we avoid confusing the account and losing pipeline momentum.

Suggested approach:
- Collect evidence from both partners (attach manifest, MQLs, dates)
- Short call with both partners + LumaHealth to align owner and handoff plan
- If both have valid claims, propose a co-sell routing with a single Redwood AE as lead and partner credit split

Can Soojin/Marissa pull the partner engagement records and any inbound introductions? Jonas/Marcus — would you weigh in on routing preferences (co-sell vs. single-party ownership)? I will loop in the LumaHealth contact if we have the right cadence.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Alliances Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (forwarded) bf_claims_snapshot.pdf

From: tom.ellis@orbitware.ai
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Overlap on LumaHealth — need claim clarity

Evelyn — appreciate the flag. OrbitWare engaged LumaHealth on 2027-03-10 for a technical discovery; I’ve exported our activity (orbit_pipeline_export.csv) and included it here. We were introduced by a shared consultant (name redacted at partner request) and have a discovery deck and technical notes.

Our preference is to keep the continuity with the engineering discovery we started, but we’re open to a handoff if the customer prefers. If BlueFjord has a signed PoC, that should factor into any priority call. Happy to join a three-way call to sort this quickly.

— Tom Ellis
Head of Solutions
OrbitWare

Attachment: orbit_pipeline_export.csv (CSV of activity / discovery timestamps)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: ava@bluefjord.com, tom.ellis@orbitware.ai
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Overlap on LumaHealth — need claim clarity

Ava / Tom — thanks both for the quick responses and the artifacts. I reviewed BlueFjord's snapshot and OrbitWare's export. To keep this clean for LumaHealth and protect partner trust, I propose the following temporary routing:

1) Short triage call (30m) with LumaHealth + both partners tomorrow 3/19 at 10am PT — goal: confirm who has signed commitments and the customer preference.
2) If BlueFjord has an active PoC with signed MOU (as Ava indicated), BlueFjord gets first right to continue PoC execution; OrbitWare retains right to finish the open technical discovery and can be invited to co-present if the customer wants combined deliverables.
3) If LumaHealth prefers a single partner for the rollout, we’ll document a co-sell split and assign Jonas as Redwood AE lead to coordinate credits and next steps. Routing_matrix_v1.xlsx will capture the options and who owns which deliverable.

Please reply with availability for the 3/19 10am PT spot or propose an alternate. I’m attaching the routing matrix draft.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Success (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: routing_matrix_v1.xlsx

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: ava@bluefjord.com, tom.ellis@orbitware.ai, sales@lumahc.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmation: triage call set — LumaHealth claim alignment (3/19 10am PT)

All — thanks for moving fast. Call confirmed: 2027-03-19 10:00am PT (Zoom link in calendar invite). Objective is narrow: confirm claim provenance and surface any signed documents. If BlueFjord confirms the MOU and LumaHealth prefers their PoC, Redwood will assign the AE lead to manage rollout and track partner incentive credits. If LumaHealth asks for a single partner for the rollout and neither partner has a signed commitment, we will offer an impartial evaluation (30-day technical consolidation) and then route based on customer outcome.

Action items before the call:
- BlueFjord: please bring the MOU & one-line POC scope (Ava)
- OrbitWare: bring discovery notes and the exported activity (Tom)
- Redwood: Jonas to bring deal context; Marissa to bring routing matrix; Evelyn to capture final decision and open follow-ups

Thanks — see you on the call.

Jonas Weber
Senior Alliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Calendar: Zoom invite created (private).
